concept.title: SNOW CAKE DUEL
concept.description: A high-intensity 15-second action sequence in a snowy night garden. Two completely redesigned warriors clash with swords in a brutal, elegant fight. At the climax, when the protagonist is about to sever the opponent's arm, the arm is revealed to be made of cake. Both characters freeze and then explode into laughter.

protagonist.name: The Yellow Viper
protagonist.face: Sharp features, intense focused eyes, no smile until the end
protagonist.clothing: Yellow tracksuit with black racing stripes, black combat boots

opponent.name: Lady Snowflake
opponent.hair: Long straight silver-white hair flowing in the wind
opponent.face: Pale porcelain skin, cold expression, high cheekbones
opponent.clothing: Black high-collar formal winter coat, dark trousers, white gloves

strict_consistency: Exact same faces and body proportions throughout
No original Kill Bill character likenesses

camera_direction.shot_type: Single continuous high-energy take with dynamic movement
camera_direction.camera_journey: Opens on a wide shot of the two women clashing in the falling snow. Camera rapidly circles and pushes in during the sword exchange, staying low and aggressive. When the final strike is about to land, the camera locks tightly on the arm. After the cake reveal it pulls back slightly to capture both women laughing.

visual_style.overall: Stylized cinematic action with strong graphic contrast
color_palette: Cold silver hair and black coat
visual_style.materials_and_texture: Crisp snow particles in the air, fabric movement, sharp sword reflections, no blood, clean and graphic
